name: semaphor
description: Answer business questions with governed analytics from your Semaphor projects.

interface.shortDescription: Answer business questions with governed analytics from your Semaphor projects.
interface.longDescription: Ask business questions in plain language and get answers grounded in your governed Semaphor data. The agent explores your semantic model, runs governed queries under your permissions, explains trends, drivers and period-over-period changes, audits dashboards, and falls back to SQL only when a question needs it.
defaultPrompt: What data can I analyze in my Semaphor project?
How did revenue change last quarter, and what drove it?
Check whether my sales dashboard's numbers are right.
